query: SELECT r.id, r.owner_id, r.visibility AS "visibility: _", r.title, r.notes, r.timezone, r.remind_at AS "remind_at: _", r.rule AS "rule: _", r.created_at AS "created_at: _", r.updated_at AS "updated_at: _", s.next_fire_at AS "next_fire_at: _" FROM reminders r LEFT JOIN reminder_schedule s ON s.reminder_id = r.id WHERE r.owner_id = $1 AND r.deleted_at IS NULL AND ($2::text IS NULL OR ($2 = 'one_off' AND r.remind_at IS NOT NULL) OR ($2 = 'recurring' AND r.rule IS NOT NULL)) AND ($3::text IS NULL OR r.visibility = $3) AND ($4::text IS NULL OR r.title ILIKE $4 ESCAPE '\') AND ($5::timestamptz IS NULL OR (r.created_at, r.id) < ($5, $6)) ORDER BY r.created_at DESC, r.id DESC LIMIT $7
